title: Authorization and Runtime Context
description: AGNAP trust context. A root grant can be authorized by local deployment policy or, optionally, by an external user or organization identity. Signed runtime evidence binds the authority to a running instance and its key. Root authorization and credential bindings are server-side records and are not disclosed to agents. The root is a union so generators emit every definition.

RootRef.title: RootRef
RootRef.description: Stable opaque reference for the root authorization and its mutable state. It survives token rotation and is shared by every descendant.

RuntimeRef.title: RuntimeRef
RuntimeRef.description: Opaque identifier assigned by a trusted runtime attestor to one running agent instance.

PrincipalRef.title: PrincipalRef
PrincipalRef.description: Pairwise opaque reference to the user or organization that authorized the root. Raw IdP subject identifiers are not sent to agents or execution services.

ApprovalRef.title: ApprovalRef
ApprovalRef.description: Opaque reference to the interaction or policy decision that approved the root authority.

SecurityDomainRef.title: SecurityDomainRef
SecurityDomainRef.description: Opaque deployment, tenant or local-owner boundary. Every root and credential binding has one even when no external identity system is used.

RuntimeEvidenceEnvelope.title: RuntimeEvidenceEnvelope
RuntimeEvidenceEnvelope.description: AGNAP extension carried in `runtime_evidence` on a root or delegated grant request. The compact JWS is issued by a runtime attestor trusted by the authorization server. The agent may relay it but cannot create or modify it.

attestation.description: Compact JWS whose payload is RuntimeEvidenceClaims.

RuntimeEvidenceClaims.title: RuntimeEvidenceClaims
RuntimeEvidenceClaims.description: A trusted statement that one runtime instance started with the named key. For a root, `parent_runtime_ref` is absent. For a child, it is required and must equal the runtime bound to the parent grant. The authorization server verifies issuer trust, audience, time, nonce and single-use event_id before binding the grant.

key_thumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the key in the GNAP client instance.

event.description: This evidence records a runtime start event.

event_id.description: Single-use event identifier remembered until exp.

RootAuthorizationContext.title: RootAuthorizationContext
RootAuthorizationContext.description: Server-side record connecting a security domain, runtime instance and root authority. It is never accepted from an agent and is not returned through token introspection. `external_authority` is optional: a local or self-hosted deployment can authorize the root through trusted deployment policy without introducing an external identity system.

ExternalAuthority.title: ExternalAuthority
ExternalAuthority.description: Optional server-side evidence that an externally authenticated user or organization approved the root. A deployment-specific identity adapter creates this object. Raw IdP subject identifiers are reduced to a pairwise opaque principal_ref and are not sent to agents or execution services.

identity_issuer.description: Issuer of the external identity used for approval, when one exists.

authorization_source.description: Whether approval came through GNAP interaction or an externally backed organizational policy.

CredentialBinding.title: CredentialBinding
CredentialBinding.description: Server-side execution-service record binding an opaque downstream credential reference to a security domain, connector and downstream account. A root may use the credential only when its security_domain_ref matches this record. An optional principal_ref can further constrain credentials enrolled through an external identity system.

account_ref.description: Connector-specific opaque account reference, not a credential.
